projects.description: The {@link Genai.Project}s, if any, that this file belongs to

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

sourceUrl.description: If set, a {@link Genai.Query.ResultToUrlSourceRelation} will be created for {@link Genai.Query.Result} that cites this source.

contentSize.description:
The content size of the source.
If the content length is not known, we use {@link File#guessMetadata} to estimate the content size.

metadata.description: The {@link Genai.SourceFile.Metadata} associated with a source. Used to filter out sources during similarity search.

eTagWhenLastProcessed.description:
The etag from the last time that the source pointed to by this source's #sourceUrl was processed. Used to check
whether the source has been updated since it was last processed.

modifiedTimeWhenLastProcessed.description:
The lastModified timestamp from the last time that the source pointed to by this source's #sourceUrl was processed.
Used to check whether the source has been updated since it was last processed for file systems that do
not (yet) have etag support

passagesFile.description:
The file where all passages from original source get stored. A representation of the Genai.SourcePassages for the
original source.

groups.description: The groups with access to this source.

status.description: The current status of the source file with respect to data ingestion

statusHistory.description: The history of statuses for the source file

isProcessing.description: Checks if the #statusHistory is curently indexing, syncing, or being removed from index.

displayUrl.description:
If set, this is the URL that should be used in the UI for any links to display the file contents. Otherwise,
#originalFile.url will be used.

collection.description: The collection that this file belongs to

originalFile.description: The file that this SourceFile represents

tablePassagesFile.description: The file with all table parsing results

imagePassagesFile.description: The file with all image parsing results

userUploaded.description:
True if user uploaded this document through the application,
otherwise false

displayGroups.description: A formatted representation of #groups for easier readability.

lastProcessedBy.description: The {@link User#email} who processed the source file.

displayLastProcessedBy.description:
Information about the user who processed the source file formatted for display in the UI

See Genai.SourceFile.StatusTimedValue#lastProcessedBy

title: A Genai.SourceFile represents a single file within a {@link Genai.SourceCollection}'s 'rootUrl`.
name: Genai.SourceFile
